why: The rule accuses the `components/ui/` folder made by hand to look like shadcn. A repository without that folder imitated no convention at all, and the N/A branch is what keeps the rule from becoming "every project has to use shadcn" — which is the opposite of what it measures. The `pass` side has a `src/botao.tsx`, a real component outside the convention, to prove the N/A is about the FOLDER and not about the absence of a component. The `fail` side has the folder with no `components.json` and keeps failing.
